optimizedDescription.value: Defines instruction, shell, and external hooks, lifecycle phases, failure semantics, and unresolved execution constraints.

optimizedContext.value:
# Hook Execution Model

## Rules
- Hook entry: `id` + exactly one `instruction:`, `run:`, or `external: { type, config }`; otherwise `SchemaValidationError`. Every workflow step supports all forms.
- `instruction:`: passive query-time text, consumed only by `GetHookInstructions(step, phase, hookId?)`; never process, side effect, predicate, effect, runtime execution, or `CompileContext` content.
- `run:`: shell command executed only by `HookRunner`; returns exit code/stdout/stderr; never agent context.
- `external:`: explicit dispatch to registered runner accepting `external.type`; no accepting runner MUST fail clearly. `HookRunner` remains shell-only.
- External hooks use same lifecycle semantics as shell hooks: pre failure fail-fast; post failure reported without rollback.
- `TransitionChange` and `ArchiveChange` auto-execute matching `run:` effects after predicates pass. Binding supplies slot/failure policy; check id does not.
- `TransitionChange`: match effects by same `from`/`to`/`along`; execute `phase = before-persist` effects (`hook.post` and `hook.pre`); `onFailure = abort`; hook checks own `RunStepHooks` dependency.
- `ArchiveChange`: execute operation-`archive` effects with `phase = before-persist` before commit and `phase = after-persist` after commit. Defaults: `hook.pre` abort/before-persist; `hook.post` collect/after-persist.

## Constraints
- `instruction:` never executes and MUST NOT enter transition predicates/effects.
- `run:` never enters agent context. All workflow steps may contain both `instruction:` and `run:`.
- Pre hooks: always fail-fast, `onFailure = abort`.
- Transition `source.post`: forward-only, `phase = before-persist`, `onFailure = abort`.
- Archive post hooks: fail-soft, `phase = after-persist`, `onFailure = collect`.
- Schema hooks precede project hooks within phase.
- Unresolved source conflict preserved:
  - `HEAD`: `TransitionChange` and `ArchiveChange` MUST select effects by binding `phase`/`onFailure`, not check id; hook execute SHALL call `RunStepHooks`; use cases MUST NOT launch it by check id; `RunStepHooks` serves hook checks + CLI; `HookRunner` handles expansion and shell escaping; `--skip-hooks` skips effects only.
  - Incoming: `TransitionChange` and `ArchiveChange` delegate hook execution to `RunStepHooks`; `RunStepHooks` serves all use cases + CLI; developer `run:` template expansion is verbatim, then `HookRunner` translates only unsupported quote syntax; callers do not shell-escape values.
